_note: Descriptive, open-source lessons for awareness and force protection. Not targeting or weapon instructions. Drafted with the local fleet, human-reviewed.

lessons.title: Small Drone Threats
lessons.insight: Small drones are increasingly used for surveillance and attacks due to their low cost and mobility. Units must integrate awareness and layered defense to counter these threats effectively.
indicators: Unidentified aerial objects hovering near key locations
Sudden power outages or communication disruptions in sensitive areas
Reports of small, fast-moving objects seen by local populations
countermeasures: Deployment of drone detection systems and visual observers
Establishment of no-fly zones with physical barriers
Training personnel to identify and report suspicious aerial activity

lessons.title: FPV and Loitering Munitions
lessons.insight: First-person view (FPV) drones and loitering munitions are used for precision strikes, requiring real-time detection and rapid response to prevent casualties.
indicators: Unmanned aerial vehicles flying at low altitudes with erratic flight patterns
Explosions or impacts in open areas without clear origin
Witness accounts of drones flying close to troops before an attack
countermeasures: Use of radar and thermal sensors for early warning
Deployment of counter-drone nets and acoustic deterrents
Conducting regular drills for rapid response to aerial threats

lessons.title: Electronic Warfare Awareness
lessons.insight: In current conflicts, electronic warfare has become a critical tool for disrupting enemy communications and command structures, often used in conjunction with cyber operations.
indicators: Unexplained communication outages in specific regions
Sudden changes in radio frequency usage patterns
Increased use of encrypted or alternative communication channels
countermeasures: Regularly updating and testing communication equipment
Implementing redundant communication systems
Training personnel on EW detection and response procedures

lessons.title: GPS Denial and Spoofing
lessons.insight: GPS denial and spoofing have been effectively used to disrupt navigation, targeting, and coordination, especially in urban or contested environments.
indicators: Inconsistent GPS coordinates across units
Navigation systems showing erratic or incorrect positioning
Increased reliance on visual or manual navigation methods
countermeasures: Using alternative navigation systems like inertial navigation or terrain matching
Conducting regular position checks using multiple sources
Training for GPS spoofing awareness and response

lessons.title: Resilient Communications Under Jamming
lessons.insight: In current conflicts, resilient communications rely on decentralized networks and frequency-hopping techniques to maintain connectivity despite jamming.
indicators: Unusual spikes in radio traffic at non-standard frequencies
Use of encrypted messaging apps with low signal strength
Presence of multiple communication nodes in a single area
countermeasures: Deployment of mesh networks with redundant pathways
Training for operators to switch frequencies rapidly
Use of low-probability-of-intercept (LPI) transmission methods

lessons.title: Command-and-Control Under Surveillance
lessons.insight: Effective command-and-control under surveillance involves using time-sensitive, non-continuous communication and leveraging terrain for cover.
indicators: Sudden changes in command post locations without prior notice
Use of prearranged signals or codes for coordination
Increased use of visual or acoustic signals during high-surveillance periods
countermeasures: Implementing staggered communication schedules
Utilizing natural terrain features for concealment
Training personnel in non-verbal command procedures

lessons.title: Field Fortification
lessons.insight: Effective field fortification in current conflicts involves using available materials to create layered defenses that enhance survivability and reduce vulnerability to indirect fires.
indicators: Presence of sandbags, trenches, or berms near tactical positions
Use of natural terrain features for cover and concealment
Reinforced barriers around key locations
countermeasures: Constructing layered field fortifications using local materials
Integrating fortifications with existing terrain features
Regularly inspecting and maintaining defensive structures

lessons.title: Dispersion
lessons.insight: Dispersal of personnel and equipment reduces the risk of mass casualties from coordinated attacks or indirect fires, enhancing overall force protection.
indicators: Multiple small groups operating in different locations
Absence of large concentrations of troops or vehicles
Use of communication methods that avoid centralized nodes
countermeasures: Implementing dispersed operations with clear communication protocols
Maintaining situational awareness to detect and respond to threats
Training units in decentralized command and control procedures

lessons.title: TCCC in Urban Environments
lessons.insight: Open tactical-casualty-care (TCCC) techniques applied in urban settings significantly improve survival rates by enabling immediate life-saving interventions at the point of injury.
indicators: Presence of improvised medical kits near casualties
Use of tourniquets and hemostatic agents in combat zones
Increased number of survivors with delayed medical care
countermeasures: Training soldiers in basic TCCC procedures
Carrying and maintaining tourniquets and hemostatic agents
Establishing casualty collection points near engagement areas

lessons.title: Early Intervention Saves Lives
lessons.insight: Prompt application of TCCC principles, such as controlling bleeding and airway management, reduces mortality by stabilizing casualties before evacuation.
indicators: Casualties showing signs of shock with early intervention
Use of field dressing and splints in combat scenarios
Reduced time between injury and medical treatment
countermeasures: Regular TCCC drills during unit training
Ensuring all soldiers are trained in basic first aid
Maintaining visibility of casualties to enable rapid response

lessons.title: Sustainment under Fire
lessons.insight: In current conflicts, maintaining sustainment under contested conditions requires decentralized logistics and rapid resupply to avoid bottlenecks.
indicators: Increased use of pre-positioned supplies in forward areas
Frequent movement of supply convoys during low-intensity engagements
Use of drones for real-time resupply coordination
countermeasures: Establishing decentralized logistics hubs near operational areas
Implementing secure, multi-route resupply strategies
Training personnel in rapid sustainment procedures under fire

lessons.title: Fuel and Ammo Management
lessons.insight: Effective fuel and ammunition management under contested conditions relies on predictive modeling and real-time tracking to prevent shortages.
indicators: Unusual spikes in fuel consumption during non-combat periods
Frequent resupply requests from forward units
Use of digital tracking systems for munitions
countermeasures: Implementing predictive logistics models based on operational tempo
Using encrypted communication for real-time inventory updates
Conducting regular audits of fuel and ammo stocks at all levels

lessons.title: Open-Source ISR Integration
lessons.insight: Units effectively integrate open-source intelligence to enhance situational awareness and identify threats in real-time.
indicators: Increased social media activity around military locations
Unusual traffic patterns near known installations
Local news reports of unexplained incidents
countermeasures: Establishing dedicated OSINT analysis teams
Implementing real-time monitoring of local media and social platforms
Training personnel to recognize and report suspicious activities

lessons.title: Community Engagement for Awareness
lessons.insight: Engaging with local communities provides critical early warning signs and improves unit awareness of potential threats.
indicators: Changes in local communication patterns
Increased civilian movement near military areas
Spontaneous reports from civilians about unusual activity
countermeasures: Developing relationships with local leaders and informants
Conducting regular community briefings and information sessions
Encouraging and facilitating civilian reporting channels

lessons.title: Movement and Route Selection
lessons.insight: In current conflicts, deliberate route selection and controlled movement patterns significantly reduce the risk of IED and mine detonation.
indicators: Unusual vehicle formations or deviations from established routes
Increased use of night movement or cover during transit
Presence of local guides or civilian escorts on high-risk routes
countermeasures: Use of pre-planned, redundant routes with multiple checkpoints
Implementation of movement control procedures including speed and spacing
Training for soldiers in route reconnaissance and terrain analysis

lessons.title: Counter-Mine/IED Awareness
lessons.insight: Soldiers who maintain constant situational awareness and recognize IED indicators are more likely to avoid threats during movement.
indicators: Unexploded ordnance found in cleared areas
Reports of suspicious objects or devices along roadsides
Use of metal detectors or other detection equipment by patrols
countermeasures: Regular training on IED indicators and minefield recognition
Establishment of mine-clearing teams with local knowledge
Encouragement of soldier reporting of suspicious objects

lessons.title: Information Environment Awareness
lessons.insight: Soldiers must actively monitor and understand the information environment to detect disinformation and maintain situational awareness.
indicators: Spread of unverified social media content in local languages
Sudden increase in rumors about enemy movements or supply lines
Unusual patterns of communication within units
countermeasures: Regular training on identifying disinformation sources
Establishing internal reporting channels for suspicious information
Encouraging cross-verification of information through peer networks

lessons.title: Morale and OPSEC Protection
lessons.insight: Maintaining morale and operational security is critical in reducing vulnerability to psychological operations and insider threats.
indicators: Unexplained changes in unit behavior or communication patterns
Increased absenteeism or low engagement during briefings
Leakage of sensitive information through informal channels
countermeasures: Implementing regular morale checks and feedback loops
Training on secure communication practices and OPSEC protocols
Promoting a culture of accountability for information sharing
